description: This file defines a REST controller in a Spring Boot application that offers health check endpoints for the service and database connectivity status. It exposes endpoints at /health, /status, and /health/db, returning JSON responses with health information and timestamps.

classes.name: HealthController
classes.description: A REST controller providing health check endpoints for service and database connectivity.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET requests at /health; returns overall service health status.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Handles GET requests at /status; returns database connectivity status.

methods.name: healthDb
methods.description: Handles GET requests at /health/db; acts as an alias for /status to check database health.
